name: week
title: The certification week
subtitle: Building Certification for Claude Code: what needs attention, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Overdue or about to lapse, oldest first.
sections.sql: select code, issue, due from attention order by due, code

sections.title: Approvals still to reach council
sections.note: Due date from the jurisdiction's lodgement clock.
sections.sql: select code, jurisdiction, council, decided_on, due_on, days_left from lodgements_due order by due_on

sections.title: Inspections in the next seven days
sections.sql: select code, job, stage, booked_for, inspector, site_address, state from inspections_due where booked_for <= current_date + 7 order by booked_for

sections.title: Waiting for a reinspection
sections.sql: select code, job, stage, inspected_on, findings from reinspections_needed order by inspected_on

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.sql: select code, rule, jurisdiction, finding from record_checks order by rule, code

name: money
title: Fees and work coming in
subtitle: Fee proposals, fees owing and approvals by month

sections.title: Fee proposals waiting for an answer
sections.sql: select code, client, site_address, approval_type, fee_cents, sent_on, days_waiting from quotes_waiting order by sent_on

sections.title: Fees owing
sections.sql: select code, client, fee_cents, uninvoiced_cents, owing_cents from fees_owing order by owing_cents desc

sections.title: Approvals by month
sections.sql: select month, approval_type, approvals from approvals_by_month order by month desc, approval_type
